evidence: Labeled P2P and changes net_processing.cpp to enforce connection limits during BIP35 mempool message handling.
rationale: Fixes an evasion of inbound transaction-relay capacity limits where inbound peers could bypass resource limits via BIP35 mempool messages. Inbound peers with fRelay=false can bypass inbound tx-relay connection accounting while still receiving full mempool inventory, undermining DoS protections introduced in #28463.
